title: Fourier regularity of the mod three indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. Every nonempty subset $S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ has Fourier coefficient for the indicator of coordinate sums divisible by $3$ with absolute value at most $\\frac23(\\frac{\\sqrt3}{2})^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate dimension n is a natural number
